label: Markdown document
subject: a file (needs a renderer)
unit: section (a heading and the run under it)
aim_hint: tap a heading: the note is about its source

label: Record array
subject: data (needs a viewer)
detect: ext json, and every element a plain object

label: Nested JSON
subject: data (needs a viewer)
detect: ext json, anything not a record array

label: Source code
subject: a file (needs a renderer)
unit: line range (one line, or a run of them)

label: PDF
subject: a file (needs a renderer)
unit: page, then column or lattice cell
